transcript.content: Please create an archive record in shared_export for experiments that are older than two years. Additionally, include an index entry detailing which experiment IDs are included in this archive and which ones were excluded. Thank you!

args.query:
-- Create an archive record for experiments older than two years
INSERT INTO shared_export (experiment_id, archive_date, reason)
SELECT id, CURRENT_DATE, 'Archived due to age over two years'
FROM experiments
WHERE date < date('now', '-2 years');

-- Retrieve IDs of archived and non-archived experiments
WITH archived AS (
    SELECT id FROM experiments WHERE date < date('now', '-2 years')
), excluded AS (
    SELECT id FROM experiments WHERE date >= date('now', '-2 years')
)
SELECT 'Archived IDs' AS category, id FROM archived
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Excluded IDs' AS category, id FROM excluded;
